name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-wellbeing-tracker
title: React Wellbeing Tracker
shortDescription: Track personal wellbeing and engagement habits in SharePoint with daily activity completion, progress bars, and week or month views.
longDescription: Log daily activities, filter by category, view consistency progress, add activities inline, and switch between light and dark modes in a responsive interface built with Fluent UI and PnPjs.
